inputs.original_text:
What we are witnessing here is a chilling exposure of the systemic violence and predatory deceit woven into the very fabric of our immigration apparatus. This is a targeted, bad-faith campaign orchestrated against the most vulnerable among us—people simply trying to navigate the system to gain legal status, only to be systematically hunted down as they leave the very courtrooms meant to oversee their cases. 

Court documents from a lawsuit challenging this practice reveal the staggering extent of the institutional rot. Federal prosecutors exposed that lawyers for ICE acknowledged an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests. Yet, despite this complete lack of legal backing, these state actors brazenly cited it anyway to justify the mass arrests of thousands of human beings. 

This is not merely bureaucratic overreach. It is a calculated assault on marginalized communities and a chilling disregard for due process that lays bare how deeply corruption and hostility toward immigrants are embedded in these agencies. This entire apparatus demands immediate, radical institutional reform.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are looking at a glaring symptom of the deep-seated institutional rot and systemic hostility that defines our broken immigration apparatus. This isn't just bureaucratic overreach; it’s a calculated assault on marginalized communities and a predatory campaign targeting the most vulnerable among us as they try to navigate the system for legal status. 

Look at the evidence laid out in court documents from a lawsuit challenging this disgraceful practice. Federal prosecutors revealed that lawyers for ICE acknowledged an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests. Yet, these state actors brazenly cited it anyway to justify the mass arrests of thousands of human beings, hunting them down right as they leave the very courtrooms meant to oversee their cases. 

This chilling disregard for due process proves that corruption and anti-immigrant animus are woven into the very fabric of these agencies. It completely exposes how vulnerable populations are treated with bad-faith cruelty by a system that desperately demands immediate, radical institutional reform.
